# Total Air Masters A/C & Heating

> Heating & air conditioning based in Katy, Texas. Total Air Masters A/C & Heating repairs and replaces AC and heating systems in Katy and nearby towns. Reviewers say Oscar answers fast, lays out several options and his crew cleans up and follows up.

## Services
- AC repair: Same-day AC repair around Katy, with gauges, a clear diagnosis and options before work starts.
- AC & heating replacement: New Carrier systems installed cleanly, with photos of the old unit so you can see why.
- Heating & furnaces: Attic furnace repair, burner and coil checks and full furnace replacements.
- Ductwork: Duct repair and replacement, with connections fabricated on site in the attic.
- Maintenance & air quality: Annual tune-ups, coil and blower cleaning, and UV lights for cleaner indoor air.
- Commercial & real estate: Rooftop units for light commercial buildings and quick HVAC checks for home sales.

## About
Total Air Masters A/C & Heating is a locally owned, Latino-owned heating and air company in Katy that has been in business for 19 years. Customers call it TAM, and most of them know owner Oscar Funes by name; Joyce keeps the office running. TAM is licensed in Texas (TACLB00026271E) and sells and installs Carrier equipment. The crew handles AC repair, system and furnace replacements, compressors, ductwork, UV lights and annual maintenance, plus rooftop units for light commercial buildings. Katy real estate agents call TAM for quick inspections before a closing, and homeowners stay on for yearly maintenance.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you offer same-day AC repair in Katy?
  A: Yes. TAM lists 24/7 availability and same-day service, and one customer had Oscar out the very next day after a lightning storm hit their system.
- Q: Is Total Air Masters licensed?
  A: Yes. TAM is a licensed Texas air conditioning contractor, license TACLB00026271E.
- Q: Do you offer payment plans on a new system?
  A: Yes. Customers mention payment plans and financing options. Ask about them when Oscar quotes your replacement.
- Q: Can you inspect the AC before a home sale?
  A: Yes. A Katy real estate agent uses TAM for nearly all of her transactions, often with same-day visits when a closing is close.
- Q: What equipment do you install?
  A: TAM sells and installs Carrier systems, and services furnaces, coils, ductwork and rooftop units of other brands.
- Q: Which areas do you serve?
  A: Katy, Cypress, Richmond, Sugar Land, Fulshear and the rest of Fort Bend County.
